title: Delphi-2M forecasts the risk of more than 1,000 diseases
summary: The September 2025 Nature version reports a GPT-style transformer trained on about 0.4 million UK Biobank participants and evaluated without retraining on 1.9 million Danish individuals. It models rates for more than 1,000 diseases and generates potential health trajectories up to 20 years ahead. This is retrospective risk modelling, with training-population biases; it does not establish a clinical benefit. The work also has a medRxiv preprint first indexed in June 2024.
organization: German Cancer Research Centre DKFZ; EMBL-EBI; University of Copenhagen

evidence.tested: Existing-record predictions in UK Biobank and Danish registries.
evidence.unknown: Not assessed: supplementary analyses and clinical deployment; population biases are discussed in the paper.
evidence.ai_role: A modified generative transformer models disease events and timing.
